description: Where the lab's extender on a wired backhaul (extender_5: prpl-agent-05, scripts/radio-lab.sh) stands in each native layout: an edge or corner the native APs leave free; in the courtyard west of its isolation wall, behind the partition, so that backhaul-isolation-recovery still isolates extender_4 and backhaul-parent-handover still hands over to extender_2. build-goldens.py checks that it comes no closer than 3 dB to the best native AP of a band-steered client, on any band.
